source: General Directorate of Agriculture (GDA), Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, Cambodia — Sweet Corn Production Handbook (ផលិតកម្មដំណំពោតផ្អែម), Appendices 4-5, in partnership with SNV (document produced circa 2017 based on the PDF metadata)
text:
The handbook includes a reference list (Appendix 4) of seed companies and corn seed varieties registered/recorded for the Cambodian market at the time of publication, listing company/brand names alongside variety codes such as CP (ស៊ីភី) 888, AAA, QQQ; Yes (យេស៊ី) 4, 9, 16, 29, 38; Advanta-Pacific Seeds 224, 339, 999-SP; Chai Tai (ចាយអូន៊ៀ) 4097, 4199, 4296, 4546, B80, K95, Y87; and Syngenta (ស៊ីជអាស៊ី) TF-222, SA-333, SA-345, SA-501, SH-0913, SH-1018, SH-1021.

Appendix 5 provides a retail price reference table for various corn/vegetable seed varieties sold in Phnom Penh at the time of publication (prices in Riel), including items such as long bean, cucumber, and sweet corn seed, with package sizes (e.g. 1000 or 200 seeds/unit) and prices per package ranging roughly from 3,000 to 13,000 Riel depending on variety and package size.

Note: this pricing and company-listing data reflects market conditions at the time the source document was produced (the PDF's embedded creation date is 2017) and should be treated as historical reference only — current seed companies, variety availability, and prices should be verified against up-to-date sources before use.
